actions.action: Cover the plant with cloth or plastic on a frame (cloche) for shade
Move the plant out of afternoon sun
Reduce watering to every other day, in the morning
Cover the plant with pest covers during heat waves

verdict.reason: The answer is scraped comments blaming heat stress or overwatering rather than immaturity, and offers shading and watering changes instead of waiting; these are unnecessary but unlikely to seriously harm the plant.
